module.Title: Decision Challenge: Mining Permission
module.Teaching: Combine comparisons, logical operators, and an if/else statement to create a complete rule.
module.PredictionExplanation: The rule requires hasPickaxe to be true and health to remain above zero.
module.DebugPrompt: Repair the logical operator, comparison, parentheses, and missing semicolon.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the complete mining permission rule. Use these exact identifiers: blocked, canMine, hasPickaxe, playerHealth, status, stoneCount. Use these exact values: 0, 1, "Mining blocked".
module.TransferPrompt: Create canFight from hasWeapon and playerHealth > 0, then set status accordingly. Use these exact identifiers: Battle, Cannot, ready. Use these exact values: "Battle ready", "Cannot fight".
module.PreviewMessage: The first complete gameplay rule is active.
